findings.oracle: Real ProcessTab with bridge set, no _attached_pid; asserts exactly one QMessageBox.warning with title=='Not Attached' and message=='No process is currently attached. Attach to a process before injecting a DLL.' (verbatim from process_tab.py:609-611), and that run_bridge_coroutine_logged was never dispatched and getOpenFileName never opened, proving the early guard fired.

Real ProcessTab with _attached_pid=1234; asserts getOpenFileName WAS invoked (guard fell through), 'Not Attached' never appears in warning titles, and an empty file selection aborts before any bridge dispatch.

Real ProviderSettingsWidget; clicks each genuine Resources QPushButton driving its real clicked->_open_resource_url connection; asserts call_count==1 per button and called QUrl.toString()==the per-label URL from the _PROVIDER_RESOURCE_LINKS table (independent source of truth). Paired failure test asserts openUrl==False surfaces show_warning(widget,'Open Link Failed', f'Could not open {label} ({url}).'). Also removed prohibited # noqa: ARG001 directives.

Real ThreadsTab with QTimer; over a 9800 ms window records perf_counter stamps on each bridge dispatch and asserts the median inter-call gap is within [2400,3700] ms around the nominal 3000 ms (threads_tab.py:43,431). A 1 ms regression median lands near 0 ms and fails; companion test_uses_3000ms_interval asserts timer.interval()==3000 directly.

Real structlog events emitted through production setup_logging; LogFileTailReader parses the on-disk JSON-Lines; asserts exact event names, level=='INFO'/'WARNING' upper-cased, logger=='intellicrack.intellicrack.tests.tail_real', module/function==this call site, strptime-parseable timestamp in documented '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' format with sane Y/M/D, line_number>0, and extras=={'widget':'hex','count':7} / {'origin':'worker'} exactly.
